data.name: DataEntryPaused
data.value: Data entry is paused until the window closes; viewing is unaffected.

data.name: EnrollmentUnavailable
data.value: Advanced Data Protection enrollment is temporarily unavailable. If your department has already purchased the addon, it remains valid — check back soon.

data.name: AddonRequiredIntro
data.value: Advanced Data Protection encrypts your department's sensitive dispatch, personnel and contact data with keys owned by your department. It requires the yearly ADP addon.

data.name: ManagingMemberOnlyPurchase
data.value: Only your department's managing member can purchase the addon and enroll.

data.name: AddonActiveManagingMemberOnly
data.value: The ADP addon is active. Only your department's managing member can complete enrollment.

data.name: EnrollmentQueuedNotice
data.value: Enrollment is queued. Migration runs during your selected overnight window ({0}–{1}, {2}). You will receive an email when each night's window opens and closes.

data.name: MigrationProgressPending
data.value: No rows have been counted yet - the first overnight window has not started.

data.name: MigrationProgressAnomalies
data.value: {0} rows could not be processed and need attention.

data.name: MigrationInProgress
data.value: Migration is in progress. Work happens only inside your overnight window ({0}–{1}, {2}); your department is in full service outside it.

data.name: ProtectionActiveDetail
data.value: Protected fields are encrypted with your department's keys; viewing them requires a signed-in member with a fresh authenticator verification.

data.name: TurnOffInstructions
data.value: To turn ADP off, cancel the addon on the subscription page. Protection stays active until the end of your current billing period. After your data is decrypted, turning it back on requires purchasing the addon again and completing a new enrollment.

data.name: OffboardingScheduledDetail
data.value: Protection remains fully active until {0}, when your data is decrypted back to standard storage over one or more overnight windows.

data.name: EndOfBillingPeriod
data.value: the end of your billing period

data.name: OffboardingInProgress
data.value: Offboarding is in progress. Protection remains in effect until your data is fully restored to standard storage.

data.name: MigrationFailed
data.value: The last migration run could not complete and will resume after review. Your department is in full service and your data remains safe. Support has been alerted; no action is needed.

data.name: Step1Header
data.value: Step 1 of 6 — What Advanced Data Protection covers

data.name: Step1Intro
data.value: ADP encrypts the sensitive content of your department's data with keys owned by your department and held in a hardened key service:

data.name: Step1ProtectedList
data.value: call names, natures, notes and addresses; call notes and attachments; contact details and notes; member sensitive data.

data.name: Step1PlaintextList
data.value: system identifiers, call numbers, priorities, statuses, timestamps, unit names and department structure — the platform needs these to route and display work.

data.name: Step1LimitSearch
data.value: Search, reporting, exports and third-party integrations cannot see protected content.

data.name: Step1LimitBigBoard
data.value: Big Board displays show a reduced "protected incident" shell instead of call details.

data.name: Step1LimitWorkflow
data.value: Workflows receive redacted payloads (protected values replaced with REDACTED).

data.name: Step1LimitNotifications
data.value: Text, email, push and voice notifications send generic content by default ("A protected dispatch is available — sign in to Resgrid").

data.name: Step1NotCompliance
data.value: Advanced Data Protection alone is not HIPAA or ePCR compliance. It is one control inside a compliance program your agency still owns.

data.name: Step2Intro
data.value: Each item below must be acknowledged by the managing member. Your acknowledgements are recorded with a version stamp.

data.name: AckCatalogScope
data.value: I understand which data families are protected (calls, call notes/attachments, contacts, member sensitive data) and that the protected-field catalog is versioned.

data.name: AckPlaintextMetadata
data.value: I understand system metadata (call numbers, priorities, statuses, timestamps, unit and department structure) stays plaintext.

data.name: AckAuthorizedServerAccess
data.value: I understand Resgrid's servers process protected values in memory when an authorized member views or edits them.

data.name: AckStepUpWindow
data.value: I understand members need a fresh authenticator (MFA) verification to view protected values, on a window my department configures (default 15 minutes; values over 60 require a recorded reason).

data.name: AckBigBoardReduction
data.value: I understand Big Board displays show reduced, protected-incident shells.

data.name: AckWorkflowRedaction
data.value: I understand workflows receive redacted payloads and cannot act on protected content.

data.name: AckDefaultEgress
data.value: I understand text/email/push/voice notifications send generic content by default, and relaxing a channel requires a separate acknowledged policy change.

data.name: AckSearchReportLimitations
data.value: I understand search, reporting, exports, integrations and offline access cannot see protected content.

data.name: AckMigrationDisable
data.value: I understand enabling runs an overnight migration, and disabling later decrypts my data over overnight windows at the end of the billing period.

data.name: AckKeyLossSupport
data.value: I understand Resgrid support cannot read protected values without an explicit, audited, department-approved support grant, and that key loss is recoverable only through the documented recovery process.

data.name: AckNotHipaaCompliance
data.value: I understand Advanced Data Protection alone is not HIPAA/ePCR compliance.

data.name: CheckManagingMemberMfa
data.value: Managing member has an authenticator enrolled

data.name: PreflightFailed
data.value: A preflight check failed. Resolve the items marked ✖ and reload this page — enrollment cannot be queued until every check passes.

data.name: Step4Intro
data.value: A read-only scan counts your department's rows and estimates how many overnight windows the migration needs. Nothing is changed by this scan.

data.name: Step5Intro
data.value: Migration runs only inside this department-local window and pauses data entry while running. Pick your quietest hours; the default is {0}–{1}.

data.name: OperationPauseDetail
data.value: While a migration window is running, no new calls, status changes, staffing changes or scheduled tasks run for your department. Viewing continues. You can abort an active window at any time and the department returns to full service immediately.

data.name: LockConsent
data.value: I understand and consent to the overnight operation pause during migration windows.

data.name: Step6Intro
data.value: Queueing enrollment re-verifies every requirement server-side and places your department in the migration queue. Departments migrate one at a time; you'll receive an email with your schedule.

data.name: ErrAcknowledgementsIncomplete
data.value: Every acknowledgement must be checked before enrollment can be queued.

data.name: ErrLockConsentRequired
data.value: The overnight operation pause must be consented to before enrollment can be queued.

data.name: ErrProtectedAccessDenied
data.value: Only the department's managing member may run this command.

data.name: ErrAddonRequired
data.value: An active Advanced Data Protection addon is required.

data.name: ErrPlanRequired
data.value: Advanced Data Protection requires a paid plan.

data.name: ErrFeatureNotAvailable
data.value: Advanced Data Protection enrollment is temporarily unavailable.

data.name: ErrInvalidState
data.value: The department's protection state does not permit this command. Reload the page for current status.

data.name: ErrInvalidWindow
data.value: A valid migration window time zone is required.

data.name: ErrCommandFailed
data.value: The command could not be completed; it may be retried.

data.name: ConfirmCancelQueued
data.value: Cancel the queued enrollment? Nothing has been migrated yet; you can enroll again later while the addon is active.

data.name: ConfirmRevokeOffboarding
data.value: Keep Advanced Data Protection active? The scheduled offboarding will be cancelled.

data.name: EmergencyContactsIntro
data.value: Emergency contacts are specific to this department and are stored with your department's data protection settings. You can add more than one.

data.name: NoEmergencyContacts
data.value: No emergency contacts have been added.

data.name: ContactSaveFailed
data.value: The contact could not be saved.

data.name: AddonSummary
data.value: Advanced Data Protection encrypts your department's sensitive fields with a key held only for your department. Once enrolled, protected values stay hidden until a member confirms who they are with a second factor, and they remain encrypted in exports, notifications and reports.

data.name: AddonFeatureStepUp
data.value: Second-factor confirmation before protected values are shown

data.name: AddonFeatureEgress
data.value: Control over what leaves in email, SMS and push notifications

data.name: AddonFeatureAudit
data.value: An audit trail of every protected read that holds no values itself

data.name: AddonManagingMemberOnly
data.value: Only the department's managing member can purchase or cancel this addon.

data.name: AddonPaidPlanRequired
data.value: Advanced Data Protection requires a paid plan.

data.name: AddonPurchaseSeparateFromEnrollment
data.value: Purchasing the addon does not encrypt anything by itself. Your department is enrolled afterwards, from the Data Protection settings page, at a time you choose.

data.name: AddonNotPurchased
data.value: Your department does not have this addon.

data.name: AddonGraceNotice
data.value: We have not received your payment yet. Protection continues until {0} — paying before then keeps everything encrypted and nothing is decrypted.

data.name: AddonOffboardingNotice
data.value: Protection ends on {0}. Until then everything stays encrypted, and the managing member can still reverse this.

data.name: AddonCancelWarning
data.value: Cancelling keeps protection running until the end of the period you have paid for. After that an overnight migration decrypts your department's data back to normal storage.

data.name: AddonCancelConfirm
data.value: Cancel Advanced Data Protection for this department?

data.name: StepUpSectionIntro
data.value: Before a protected value is shown, Resgrid asks the member for a code from their authenticator app. You can switch that prompt off for individual applications.

data.name: StepUpSectionWarning
data.value: Leave this on wherever you can. Switching it off means anyone already signed in on that device can reveal protected data without proving who they are — worth accepting on a dispatch console during an incident, much less so on a phone that can be lost.

data.name: StepUpSaveConfirm
data.value: Change the verification prompt for this department?

data.name: StepUpSaveFailed
data.value: The verification settings could not be saved.

data.name: StepUpManagingMemberOnly
data.value: Only the department's managing member can change this.

data.name: StepUpAuditNotice
data.value: Every change is recorded with who made it and when.
